The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b9d8fcffac455475), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let T be an invertible mixing probability- preserving transformation. For any fixed s ≥ 2, g1, . . . , gs ∈ L∞(µ), and integer times t1, . . . , ts, ∫︂ X s ∏︂ j=1 gj(Ttj x) dµ(x) −→ s ∏︂ j=1 ∫︂ X gj dµ as min i̸=j |ti − tj| −→ ∞. For s = 1 the equality holds for every time.
